privacy.title: How I handle your data.
privacy.analytics: I use PostHog for privacy-friendly navigation analytics: scroll depth, time on page and basic events (downloads, project clicks, form submits). I do not share data with third parties, I do not use advertising tracking cookies, and I do not build personal profiles.
privacy.cookies: If you decline cookies, only strictly necessary ones (language, theme) are stored. You can change your preference from the "Cookies" button in the footer.
privacy.contactForm: If you write through the contact form, your name, email and message arrive directly to my inbox and are not stored anywhere else.
